title: Refine Camera-Forward Player Facing
objective: Refine scripts/player.gd so movement remains camera-relative while the visible character smoothly faces camera-forward whenever moving, including strafing and backpedaling, without changing idle camera freedom or existing gameplay.
acceptance: W moves camera-forward and follows camera-yaw changes while held
A and D remain camera-relative strafes while target character facing remains camera-forward
S remains camera-relative backward movement while target character facing remains camera-forward
diagonal input is normalized to the configured movement speed
moving rotation approaches camera yaw smoothly without snapping, while idle camera movement does not force body rotation
mouse yaw, mouse pitch, pitch limits, capture behavior, gravity, collision, interaction, objective, exit, completion, and restart behavior remain intact
restroom_001, restroom_002, and restroom_003 regressions and the Linux exported runtime all pass
the only changed source file is scripts/player.gd and no new movement mechanic, animation system, or character replacement is introduced
